$comment: Build profiles, so the one thing this project still needs — a session with a real
phone — is a single command rather than an afternoon of setup.
`preview` is the one that matters: it produces an installable build (an .apk you
can sideload, an internal-distribution .ipa) without touching a store. That is the
profile that closes four Definition of Done boxes at once — runs on device,
performance on mid-tier Android, VoiceOver and TalkBack.
Nothing here has been run. EAS builds on Expo's infrastructure and needs an
authenticated account, which this environment does not have. The config is written
from the documented schema and should be treated as a first draft until one build
has actually gone through — see docs/plan/device-pass.md.

development.$comment: A dev client, for iterating with Metro attached to a real device.

preview.$comment: The device-pass build. Installable, no store, production JS.

preview-simulator.$comment: Same thing for an iOS Simulator, for whoever has a Mac.

$comment: Store builds. Do not run this until the device pass has been done — shipping
